title: neesia altissima
intro: Neesia altissima, commonly known as the tall neesia or yellow neesia, is a plant species in the family Melastomataceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing fever, alleviating inflammation, and promoting wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Neesia altissima include being an antiseptic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Neesia altissima include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
